source: Enchanting, second mode — Pathfinder 1st Edition magic item creation (Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Craft Wondrous Item, Forge Ring). Open Game Content, Open Game License v1.0a — see OGL.txt.
note: This file is the book-faithful mode's catalogue, and it is deliberately NOT the essence shelf: rules/magicitem.py reads only this file (plus homebrew/magic-items), while rules/enchanter.py reads the whole content/materials folder as the shared shelf. Kinds: weapon_property and armour_property (priced as BONUS EQUIVALENTS — `plus` is added to the enhancement bonus for pricing and counts against the +10 cap), wondrous (slot items priced in gp outright, `slot` from rules/tables.py SLOTS). `spell` is the prerequisite spell as a real id in content/spells; the creator satisfies it either by knowing it (rules/casting.knows) or by consuming a potion whose stock entry carries "holds_spell": that id. Permanency prerequisites from the book are dropped — see docs/enchanting.md. `caster_level` is the book's minimum; the working's DC is 5 + caster level. Effects are rules/effectspec.py specs where the vocabulary reaches and narrative where it does not; a guessed spec would be a fact nobody wrote.
